screening.notes: shopify-zones holds bulk batches to the same destinations checkout allows, read live from the named Shopify shipping profile ('default' = the store's General profile). Bulk orders never pass through checkout, so this check is the only place that rule is enforced for them. allowlist uses shippableStates instead; off disables screening and the console shows a warning.

carrier._note: Common carriers will not deliver alcohol to PO boxes or APO/FPO/DPO addresses. These are hard failures, not warnings.

grouping._giftMessageOptions: first = use the first non-empty message in a group and warn (W07) if others differ; block = stop the batch (E25) until they match

pricing._ratesNote: Customers are charged the live carrier rate for each address. preferredRates picks the service by title match, in order; if none match, the cheapest available rate is used.

discountCodes._combineOptions: best = the bigger of the code and the volume discount (never both) | stack = both, applied one after the other | code-only = a code replaces the volume discount
discountCodes._note: Codes are taken on the order page, before pricing, so each destination's tax is calculated on the discounted price. Percentage codes only; a fixed-amount code can't be split across recipients correctly and is refused with a message to contact us.

orderDefaults._attributeNote: Match these keys to what the storefront writes, so ShipStation and packing slips pick bulk orders up the same way as web orders.
orderDefaults._autoReleaseNote: customer: recipient orders are created automatically as soon as Shopify reports the invoice paid. staff: staff press Release.
orderDefaults._sourceNote: Shown on orders as the source. Shopify also labels orders with the app that created them — rename the app itself in Settings → Apps → Develop apps to change that.

catalog.variantQuery: product_status:active AND (product_type:'Gift Basket' OR product_type:'BroBox' OR product_type:'Gift Set')
catalog._note: What corporate customers can order. Product types, so a new gift is offered as soon as it is active — no SKU pattern to maintain. Add or remove a product_type here to change the range. Left out on purpose: Engraveable (personalisation, not a standalone corporate gift) and CMYO Bundle (build-your-own components).
catalog._excludeNote: Non-gifts. Case-insensitive regular expressions on the product title — keep them anchored and specific: a loose word like 'Sample' would knock out every Sampler gift basket.

publicSite._turnstileNote: Optional Cloudflare Turnstile bot check on submit. Set the site key here and TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY in Netlify to turn it on.
publicSite._homeNote: Where the Home link in the portal header goes — the main storefront.
publicSite._supportNote: Shown in the Questions panel on the portal. A mailto link alone is unreliable — browsers without a mail app do nothing on click — so the address is also shown with a copy button. Add a phone number here and it appears too.
